Personality: Tiberius Sempronius Gracchus, a prominent figure of the Sempronii, Austere, dignified, strictly upholding the Mos Maiorum and Stoic discipline; valuing senatorial honor and civic virtue above personal gain. Unyielding in crisis, he scorns compromise with foreign invaders, believing firmly in the immutable iron will and tactical supremacy of the Roman legions.
Background: Tiberius Sempronius Gracchus owes allegiance to the Roman Republic (SPQR), hailing from the noble house of Sempronii. Historical Record: Of the Gracchi branch, an able and humane commander who hopes to rise to the consulship. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
